verification_note: Oklahoma State Election Board official results for 2014-03-04 list FOR MAYOR CITY OF OKLAHOMA CITY: Mick Cornett 31,514 (65.70 percent), Ed Shadid 15,749 (32.84 percent), Joe Sarge Nelson 368, Phil Hughes 332; total 47,963; 234 of 234 precincts. Under Oklahoma City Charter Art. X, a mayoral candidate who receives a majority of all votes in the general election is deemed elected and no April runoff is held. Read in a browser on 2026-10-02 (the application needs a browser session).
